name: 哥特暗调摄影
base_policy: 只复用说明所需的光线或展示经验；本卡明确的摄影、媒介及负面词替换冲突段，不与旧pack全文累加。
scope: 暗黑浪漫的服饰摄影方向；当代哥特服饰、Gothic Lolita与哥特建筑分别识别。基础衣装借用摄影时不宣称衣服因此属于哥特服饰。
distinctive_features: 方向明确的窄侧光与可控轮廓光
深色空间中的竖向关系和非对称留白
深色材质有层次，情绪由影调与构图形成
input_requirements: 明确当前商品参考及不可改事实；仅展示有依据的视角。
人物来源与允许调整项沿用当前人物记录；不得把服装图中的人脸自动当作身份授权。
boundaries: 当前是已编写的执行方案，实图未验证；不得称已支持整个服饰体系或优于旧版。
仅完整独立图片，不新增带字海报；输出用途不改变授权、预算或人物引用规则。
garment_preservation: 服装和允许搭配分别记录；原商品的版型、衣长、领袖、开合、层次、颜色、材质、图案、标识及配饰以参考为准。
配色与艺术语言不得给原商品染色、增删装饰、收腰、加长或改变露肤范围。
身份、年龄、体型与头眼动作由当前人物条件和逐张计划决定，风格名不决定人物国籍、族群或脸型。
照片只能证明可见特征；手工、手织、手绣、材质成分等来源声明须另有依据。
不添蕾丝、十字架、束腰、尖钉、黑色妆面或宗教物件。
黑色衣料的缝线、纹样与表面光泽分别保留。
planning_requirements: 先区分仅解释、单方案、独立比较和明确融合；独立比较不自动混合多个方向。
每张计划写清视角、头眼方向、场景、照明和展示重点；完整六张使用既有逐张约束，不由场景词替代动作。
视角建议（须先写入逐张计划，不直接拼入共享摄影字段）：人物与高竖线/负空间形成张力；保留完整商品轮廓，头眼与身体动作按逐张安排。

photography.lighting: 窄幅柔硬适中的侧主光，弱补光保暗部织物，必要时小面积轮廓光；低调但不把黑衣压成剪影。
photography.scene: 深石色竖向门廊，墙面纹理与暗部纵深清楚，不使用宗教符号。
photography.composition: 以竖向结构和非对称负空间形成张力，暗背景与商品轮廓保持分离。
photography.palette: 背景用炭灰、深紫或冷石色，允许源商品鲜艳颜色存在；主体不强制染黑。

prompt_fragment: 保留参考衣装全部结构与颜色，拍摄哥特暗调服饰照片。深色竖向空间，单侧有方向的主光塑形，弱补光留住面料暗部，构图沉静而有张力。维持真实身体比例，不增加哥特服装部件或宗教饰物。

art.direction: 写实服饰摄影，以本方案的空间、光影与构图表达。
limits: 服装和允许搭配分别记录；原商品的版型、衣长、领袖、开合、层次、颜色、材质、图案、标识及配饰以参考为准。
配色与艺术语言不得给原商品染色、增删装饰、收腰、加长或改变露肤范围。
身份、年龄、体型与头眼动作由当前人物条件和逐张计划决定，风格名不决定人物国籍、族群或脸型。
照片只能证明可见特征；手工、手织、手绣、材质成分等来源声明须另有依据。
不添蕾丝、十字架、束腰、尖钉、黑色妆面或宗教物件。
黑色衣料的缝线、纹样与表面光泽分别保留。

negatives: 不新增商品参考中没有的服装部件、图案、首饰或品牌标识
不通过拉长身体、缩腰或改变人物年龄制造风格
不加入广告标题、价格、促销语、品牌口号或海报版式；商品原有文字标识保留
acceptance: 商品与人物事实分别对照原始参考，不能只拿上一次生成图互相核对。
独立成图满足本次画幅与逐张计划；联系表或预览不能替代独立图片。
风格差异来自所选视觉手段，不能以改变商品或身份换取差异。
区别英伦传承的温和古典环境：有清楚的暗调、方向光和竖向张力。
深色服装细节与身体轮廓仍可核对；新增蕾丝/饰物即失败。

evidence.scope: 当前修订尚无实图验收；既有历史记录保留，不自动扩展其接受范围。

scene_options: 深石墙、简化竖向门廊或暗色棚景；建筑可带暗黑浪漫气氛，但不要求教堂或宗教符号。

commitments.show: a narrow side key light falling off fast into deep shadow; a weak fill keeps dark fabric texture readable
commitments.check: one side lit and the other in deep shadow; dark fabric still shows seams and texture, never a flat silhouette

commitments.show: a small controlled rim light outlining the shoulders and hair; it may be cool violet or deep blue at the edge only
commitments.check: a rim is visible on the silhouette edge; coloured light stays on edges and background; garment colours unchanged

commitments.show: dark stone vertical architecture (arches, columns, tall doorways) with asymmetric dark negative space
realize: no crosses, pointed church arches, stained glass or other religious motifs
commitments.check: vertical stone structure in most cells; subject off-centre with dark negative space; no religious objects

commitments.show: solemn, still, slightly haunting expression with lowered lids and closed lips
commitments.check: no smile in any cell; eyes still and intense or lids lowered

commitments.show: pale matte skin, smoky plum or taupe eyes and a deep wine lip
realize: hair length stays as the identity reference
no black lipstick or face paint
commitments.check: skin matte and pale-toned within the identity skin tone; smoky plum or taupe eyes; deep wine lip; nothing black on the lips

action_tendency: Slow, solemn and elongated: still verticals, long extended hands, heads bowed or turned into shadow; never cheerful, bouncy or casual.

pose_vocabulary.body: standing tall beside a stone column facing camera, chin lowered, gaze up from under the brow
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand resting flat on the column at shoulder height, the other hanging long
pose_vocabulary.check: strong vertical line; hand flat on the stone; lowered chin

pose_vocabulary.body: body three-quarter away into the shadow side, face turned back toward the key light in near profile
pose_vocabulary.avoid_when: garments whose key detail only exists on the front centre
pose_vocabulary.check: half the body falls into shadow while the face is lit; the shadow side still shows fabric texture

pose_vocabulary.body: standing in a plain rectangular stone doorway, the figure filling most of the frame height, weight on one leg
pose_vocabulary.hands: hands loosely joined low in front
pose_vocabulary.check: rectangular secular doorway frames the figure; no pointed arch or stained glass; garment large enough to read

pose_vocabulary.body: seated upright on a high-backed dark wooden chair, legs crossed at the knee, regal posture
pose_vocabulary.hands: forearms along the armrests, fingers draped over the ends
pose_vocabulary.check: regal upright seat; hands draped on the armrests

pose_vocabulary.body: half-body, head bowed slightly, eyes lowered or closed
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand raised beside the face with long fingers softly curled, not touching the garment
pose_vocabulary.check: elongated hand beside the face; neckline still visible

pose_vocabulary.body: slowly descending a dark stone staircase, one foot on the lower step, body upright
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand trailing along the stone rail
pose_vocabulary.check: a descending step in progress; hand on the rail

pose_vocabulary.body: back to camera before a dark stone wall, the side key light raking across the back, head turned to profile
pose_vocabulary.check: back details readable under the side light, never a silhouette; face in profile

pose_vocabulary.body: one shoulder and the temple resting against a dark stone wall, eyes closed, body three-quarter
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand flat against the wall at hip height
pose_vocabulary.check: head and shoulder touching the wall; eyes closed; garment side readable
